reviews.text: Small Group Tour Sedona to Grand Canyon. My friend and I took this tour in June 2026. Our tour guide, Rasa, was possibly the best tour guide I’ve had in the US or abroad. Additionally, he has to be the most patient person I have ever met. The bus was comfortable and I felt safe traveling on scenic 89A (which is beautiful but can be intimidating). A word of caution: for people who get carsick - maybe this tour is not for you! The twisty roads and long day may be taxing. Does not stand behind their tours.. Viator would not stand behind a non-performing vendor. Tour group rescheduled several time, effectively did not show up on time (over 3 hours late). Shocked as I had a few good experiences with tours through Viator. 

Viator claimed in writing that “on how the tour operates, we don’t have any access to that/ that would be outside our scope and this is also a tourist location (Paris) which is not owned by us nor the tour company who operates your activity.” Not sure what all that means, but to me I was out $800 for a tour booked through Viator/Tripadvisor. 

The tour was originally scheduled for 11am. 
At around 10am of same days they asked to reschedule to 1pm. 
I said it was not ideal, but after multiple requests I agreed. 
At 11 they asked to push back to 1:15pm. 
At 12:33 pm they pushed back to 1:30. 
I started waiting in the rain at 1pm as they request their guests to be 20-30 minutes early. 
I text reminders at 1:25 and 1:37 twice that we are getting soaked.
At 1:37, the guide texts me that she is still with the previous group and “waiting for the coats… in these days there is long wait everywhere.”
At 1:40 she texts “ Still waiting, I’ll text you/ call you when I’ll be outside”
At 1:40 I say I have to cancel especially since I find out that the tour would not start until we go through a 60-90 minute security line. 
At 1:42, the guide texts that “I’m not the boss of the company, I’m a simple guide. I’ll try to do my best. 
At 2:05 pm she sends me a picture that she is outside, which means our tour probably would not have started until 3pm or so with the line. 

Viator’s decision clearly states that your money is not safe and you are the mercy of the unknown faceless tour companies in whatever destination you are booking. Almost a license to steal for shady tour companies. Unreal!!!
